summary: The desktop composer footer stays on one row at every width. The runtime-mode select and the new-chat checkout, branch and worktree selects become chips that open a popover list, with the same options, labels, tooltips and arrow-key behaviour. Container queries shorten the lower priorities first (effort, checkout, mode), then show the model only, then move mode, checkout and effort into a "..." menu. The context meter and Send never move.

reactNativeIos.reason: The Expo app does not render this footer. Its composer has its own layout, with no runtime-mode select and no checkout chips.

nativeAndroid.reason: The Compose composer does not render this footer. Nothing it shows changes.

sharedBackendApi.reason: A renderer layout change only. The runtime-mode, effort and checkout values sent to the backend are unchanged.

storageDataMigration.reason: No stored data changes. The same five runtime-mode values and the same draft checkout options are saved.

updateRelease.reason: An unconditional desktop renderer change with no flag, package identity, signing, update-channel or rollout change.

automated: SB_VISUAL_SCOPE=screens npm run test:e2e:visual (composer-footer-360/680/1200, composer-landing, composer-overflow-menu, and a one-row offsetTop check on the landing, chat, running, queued and narrow composers)
